IC1: Women of child-bearing potential [AND] that [NOT] do not practice adequate contraception.
IC3: Received more than one primary chemotherapy regimen.
IC4: Concomitant [OR] or previous malignancies with [NOT] the exception of adequately treated basal cell [OR] or squamous cell skin cancer [OR], in situ cervical cancer [OR], incidental carcinoid [OR], or other cancer from which the patient has been disease free for 5 years.
IC6: Concurrent severe medical problems unrelated to the malignancy which would limit full compliance with the study.
IC7: Received radiation [AND] to more than 10% of bone.
IC8: Prior treatment with topotecan [OR] or gemcitabine.
IC9: Hypersensitivity to camptothecin [OR] or nucleoside analogues.
IC10: Use of an investigational agent within 30 days.
